The purpose of this work product is to facilitate the management of defects by:

  • Tracking defect progress from identification to resolution
  • Providing a list of known issues to affected users
  • Communicating items that need to be addressed by those responsible for making the necessary corrections

Information captured in this work product typically includes, but is not limited to, the following:

  • Unique identification number
  • Date of submission
  • Detailed defect description
  • Defect categorization
  • Defect status
  • Defect priority
  • Defect severity
  • Defect root cause classification
  • Defect owner
  • Target resolution date
